No source-target batch pairs or measured property-drift and transfer-risk labels are present.
No independent multirate reaction families with experimental activation-energy and mechanism-interval targets are present.
The XRD project does not provide enough independent families with instrument metadata, calibrated phase fractions, and uncertainty targets.

next_action: Retain the licensed projects as source evidence only; obtain exact record-level targets with enough independent families before any training or promotion.
